name: TJWA_TC_DL_NEG_001 - [Negative] Invalid mobile number blocks submission
fullName: TJWA_TC_DL_NEG_001 - [Negative] Invalid mobile number blocks submission
description:
[Negative] Verify submitting the dealer lead form with an invalid (too-short) mobile number does not succeed.

Expected: The lead form should remain open and should not reach the thank-you/success state when the mobile number is invalid.
